scripts.dev: concurrently "mix phx.server" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.mobile:dev: adb reverse tcp:5173 tcp:5173 && adb reverse tcp:4000 tcp:4000 && cd mobile && CAP_DEV=true bunx cap run android
scripts.mobile:ios: cd mobile && CAP_DEV=true bunx cap run ios
scripts.mobile:sync: cd frontend && bun run build && cd ../mobile && bunx cap sync
scripts.mobile:build: cd frontend && bun run build && cd ../mobile && bunx cap sync && bunx cap build android
scripts.mobile:sync:prod: cd frontend && bun run build --mode production && cd ../mobile && bunx cap sync
scripts.mobile:build:prod: cd frontend && bun run build --mode production && cd ../mobile && bunx cap sync && bunx cap build android
scripts.mobile:build:ios:prod: cd frontend && bun run build --mode production && cd ../mobile && bunx cap sync && bunx cap open ios
